overzichtModel.query: FROM (SELECT f.*, (IF(ISNULL((SELECT sum(b.bedrag) FROM betalingen AS b INNER JOIN shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb ON b.betaling_id = sfb.betaling_id WHERE sfb.shop_id = f.shop_id)),0,(SELECT sum(b.bedrag) FROM betalingen AS b INNER JOIN shop_factuur_betalingen AS sfb ON b.betaling_id = sfb.betaling_id WHERE sfb.shop_id = f.shop_id))) AS totaal_betalingen FROM shop_facturen AS f :f.where) AS f JOIN shop_regel_producten AS p ON f.shop_id = p.shop_id LEFT JOIN klanten AS k ON f.klant_id = k.klant_id

veld.naam: sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal) - (f.korting_bedrag) - (sum(((p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal)) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal)))
veld.label: Excl. BTW

veld.naam: sum(IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0)) - (f.korting_bedrag) - (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),1))))
veld.label: Excl. BTW Hoog

veld.naam: sum(IF(p.product_btw = 6 OR p.product_btw = 9,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0)) - (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 6 OR p.product_btw = 9,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw))
veld.label: Excl. BTW Laag

veld.naam: (sum(((IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),0))) / (100 + p.product_btw) * p.product_btw)) * (1 - (f.korting_bedrag) / (sum(IF(p.product_btw = 19 OR p.product_btw = 21,(p.product_prijs * p.product_aantal),1))))
veld.label: BTW Hoog
